newsitem.title: REPUBLIC OF IRELAND: Tuskar to acquire stake in Nigeria oil lease.
newsitem.headline: Tuskar to acquire stake in Nigeria oil lease.

text.p: Irish-based oil-exploration compant Tuskar Resources Plc said on Monday it had entered a deal with UK firm Allied Energy to acquire a 40 percent working interest in an oil mining lease offshore Nigeria.

The consideration for the acquisition will be the issue to Allied of 617,801,938 new ordinary shares, representing 65 percent of Tuskar's enlarged share capital, Tuskar said in a statement. Allied will also be issued with warrants to subscribe for a further 50,000,000 ordinary Tuskar shares.
The deal is conditional on shareholder approval, Tuskar said.

Tuskar said it had entered into further agreements with Allied Energy's parent company Camac/Allied, and had received a $6.0 million loan from Camac/Allied to assist in the funding of its working capital requirements.
"Tuskar believes that a strategic alliance with the Camac/Allied group...affords an excellent opportunity for the growth of the company," it said.
"The impact of the acquisition on Tuskar's balance sheet will be to increase Tuskar's fixed assets by approxiamtely 7.7 million punts and the shareholders funds by the same amount," Tuskar said.
Tuskar also announced its results for the year to March 31, reporting a pre-tax loss of 1.17 million punts versus 0.35 million the previous year.
